# From _spreadsheets + portals_  to in-workflow insight.

How MyCare Medical replaced legacy, out-of-workflow processes with point-of-care technology across five EHRs.

![Vim](https://www.getvim.ai/assets/vim-icon-blue.svg)×MyCare Medical

Share

CustomerMyCare Medical

Footprint50K+ VBC Medicare patients · FL & TX

EHRs5 EHR systems · single integration

Vim productsQuality Gaps · Diagnosis Gaps

01Before Vim

Spreadsheets. Portals. Burnout.

MyCare had no consistent way to get actionable clinical information to providers at the point of care. Manual, out-of-workflow processes like spreadsheets and portals limited visibility into provider engagement and activity — and drove provider burnout from labor-intensive processes.

- No consistent point-of-care information
- Manual spreadsheets and portals
- Limited visibility + provider burnout

02Our mission

Scale without the busywork.

As a value-based MSO with multiple EHR systems, MyCare wanted a new approach to value-based operations that could scale — getting actionable clinical information to providers at the point of care, without the manual, labor-intensive processes driving physician burnout.

- Deliver actionable insight at the point of care
- Scale across multiple EHR systems
- Reduce labor-intensive, out-of-workflow work

One integration, five EHRs

## Quality + diagnosis gaps, _bidirectional_ inside every visit.

MyCare deployed Vim’s point-of-care platform to replace legacy, hard-wired approaches with a scalable, easy-to-implement solution. Through a single integration, MyCare rolled out Vim’s Quality Gaps and Diagnosis Gaps applications across five EHRs, embedding critical insights directly into provider workflows with bidirectional functionality.

- Single integration across five EHRs
- Quality + Diagnosis Gaps in-workflow
- Bidirectional write-back to the chart
